parameters.content:
## AI Support Inbox Triage (entry)
Polls Gmail every minute for new unread email.
Each email is handed to its **own** sub-workflow execution, so one slow approval in Slack never blocks the next email.

**Test with sample emails** runs 3 sample emails (billing / bug / spam) through the real AI steps in dry-run mode.
